hero.title: Integrating Technology, Inspiring Learners.
paragraphs: As the EdTech Coach at the British International School Hanoi, I work at the intersection of technology, teaching, and school improvement. My role is about more than just tools-it's about strategic planning and change management that help schools use technology in ways that truly make a difference. I've led whole-school audits, written AI policies tailored to education, and designed professional development that actually shifts practice and enhances student learning.

My path into education is shaped by a background in software development, digital humanities, and international teaching. That mix gives me a practical lens: I understand what's technically possible, but I'm equally focused on what genuinely works in the classroom. Alongside coaching, I also teach Computer Science at IBDP and IGCSE, which keeps me connected to the daily realities teachers and students face.
